g.text: Last updated Sep 21 · applies to lazynext.com + all subdomains
An autonomous AI company that builds, deploys and operates software on your infrastructure and keys.
Agents act through credentials you provide. You own what it builds.
You set budgets; the finance agent enforces them and reports weekly.
No spam, no scraping behind auth, nothing illegal. Agents refuse by design.
